use passport_common::{
    passport_main,
    Alpha3CountryCode,
    AGE_RULES_SIZE,
    HASH_PATH_SIZE,
    DG1Data,
    SignedAttrsData,
    EContentData,
    CSC_CERT_TYPE,
};

fn main(
    certificate_registry_root: pub Field,
    certificate_registry_index: Field,
    revocation_tree_root: pub Field,
    masterlist_tree_root: pub Field,
    certificate_registry_hash_path: [Field; HASH_PATH_SIZE],

    certificate_tags: [Field; 3],
    salt: Field,
    country: Alpha3CountryCode,

    tbs_certificate: [u8; 1600],
    csc_pubkey: [u8; 512],
    csc_pubkey_redc_param: [u8; 513],
    dsc_signature: [u8; 512],
    exponent: u32,

    current_date: pub u64,
    rule_ages: pub [i8; AGE_RULES_SIZE],
    rule_ops: pub [u8; AGE_RULES_SIZE],
    rules_len: pub u32,

    dg1: DG1Data,

    dsc_pubkey: [u8; 384],
    dsc_pubkey_redc_param: [u8; 385],
    sod_signature: [u8; 384],

    signed_attributes: SignedAttrsData,
    e_content: EContentData,
    pss_salt_len: u32,

    csc_expiry: u32,
    timestamp: pub u32,
    csc_fingerprint: Field,
    schema_version: pub u16,
) -> pub Field {
    passport_main::<1600, 512, 384, 0, 1>(
        certificate_registry_root,
        certificate_registry_index,
        revocation_tree_root,
        masterlist_tree_root,
        certificate_registry_hash_path,
        certificate_tags,
        salt,
        country,

        tbs_certificate,
        csc_pubkey,
        csc_pubkey_redc_param,
        dsc_signature,
        exponent,

        current_date,
        rule_ages,
        rule_ops,
        rules_len,

        dg1,

        dsc_pubkey,
        dsc_pubkey_redc_param,
        sod_signature,

        signed_attributes,
        e_content,
        pss_salt_len,

        csc_expiry,
        timestamp,
        csc_fingerprint,
        schema_version,
        CSC_CERT_TYPE,
    )
}
